_doc: The campaign: five road maps then the boss, in order. anchors: top-left cell of each 2x2 turn square. slots (optional): v = tripline across a horizontal stretch at [row, col], h = across a vertical one, t = turret pad top-left [row, col] facing [dr, dc]; without them the rules place pads past every corner and a tripline on every other cell of each straight. hp multiplies every enemy's health and pace is how many steps of the difficulty curve each wave climbs (difficulty, tuned with tools/balance.ts). theme: what the art shows (its pieces, floors and walls come from the art pack, art/pack/pack.json; its layout from art/maps/<id>/layout.json). boss: the boss map's arms, tuned with tools/balance.ts. msgBox (optional): [row, first column] of the message box when not where rules.ts messageBox would put it. See CLAUDE.md, Map progression.

maps.name: Cargo Bay
maps.theme: the base's cargo bay: freight containers, stacked crates, pallet racks, loading docks and a gantry crane over a wide plated floor

maps.name: Hab Ring
maps.theme: the habitation ring: crew quarters with bunks and lockers, a mess hall with tables, washrooms, a small gym, narrow side corridors and bulkhead doors

maps.name: Regolith Mine
maps.theme: a mine dug into the moon's rock: rough cave walls, boulders and rubble, ore carts on rails, drilling rigs, support struts and conveyor belts

maps.name: Reactor
maps.theme: the reactor deck: round reactor vessels, coolant tanks, thick pipe runs and valves, turbines, cable trays and grated catwalks

maps.name: Hydroponics
maps.theme: the hydroponics farm: long rows of grow beds full of leafy plants, water tanks, irrigation pipes, grow-light panels and seed trays

maps.name: Airlock
maps.theme: the breached airlock where the robots got in: the outer door, suit racks, oxygen tanks and decontamination booths, with the Boss Bot on the left
